epics.name: Arrive and fly
epics.story: You open the page. A world exists, you are in a ship in it, and the controls answer. Nothing else in the game can happen until this does.

epics.name: Mine the belt
epics.story: You fly a small ship at some rocks. You shoot one, it breaks, and the pieces are worth something. You scoop them up and the bar at the bottom fills. When it fills, you are owed something.

epics.name: Spend the point, or save for the hull
epics.story: You have a point. Put it into guns, shields or engines and get a little better now; or hold out, max everything, and trade the whole ship for a bigger frame and lose every upgrade you bought. That is the only real decision in the game.

epics.name: Fight, die, and lose the cargo
epics.story: Your gun costs energy, so you cannot hold the trigger forever. Your shields soak the first hits and come back if you break away. When you lose, your gems spill for anyone to take and you start again small.

epics.name: The run ends and is remembered
epics.story: The session stops, and what you did survives it: the score, the ship you were flying, the state that has to be there when you come back.
